notes: When you tap a word to color it, the color now stays put. Split-screen reactions stay on one clip for the whole video. You can add an Instagram first comment that auto-posts right after each video, and it picks one from your list. The submit use-case menu now matches the rest of the app, and you can save your hashtags and captions as a set and load it on any account.
_urls: urls are GitHub Release assets (stable, public, direct .exe/.dmg) and sha256 pins the exact binary - the 2.9.8+ updater verifies the download against it before offering to install. Assets use customer-friendly names (Remixa-Windows.exe / Remixa-Mac.dmg); the release TAG carries the version. Mac dmg is signed + notarized + stapled (no Gatekeeper warning) from the cloud-Mac CI.
